title: Cube Craft: Minecraft inspired demo
subtitle: Unreal Engine 5 | Blueprints | Building Game
content: A first person building game created using Unreal Engine 5 and Blueprints.
summary: Created a first-person Unreal Engine 5 building prototype with Blueprints, raycasting, and save/load.
description: A Minecraft-inspired first-person building prototype developed in Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints. This was my first Unreal prototype and a practical way to learn the engine through a playable project.
roles: Designed and developed the concept of the game
Used Blueprints to create a playable demo
Modular code to expand, asset integration (models, animations)
details: In this first-person building prototype, players gather resources and place blocks to construct a base using six block types. The project includes raycasting, actor spawning, UI systems, and save/load functionality. It was built as a hands-on Unreal Engine 5 learning project using Blueprints. Credit for the 3D model assets goes to Tidal Flask Studios.
